_comment: Grow's Sarf world: Marah al-Arwah, bab by bab, read through Dikunquz's commentary (the matn is quoted inside it). Hand-written. Every `ar` and `source` is the file's own words (backend/data/books/openiti/<file>); src/lib/bookLesson.test.js checks each, and that a `whole` part quotes every paragraph of its headings (`kitabs`). The commentary's own '[شرح ديكنقوز]' headings continue a section rather than end it (`continues`); `skip` lists headings not taught.
_cards: teach {title, ar, en} · choose {ask, ar?, options, answer: index, arabic-options?, source, why} — an `ar` with ____ is a gap the answer fills · pick {ask, options: [{text, right?}], source, why} · sort {ask, into, items: [[text, bucket]], source, why} · order {ask, steps (in the right order), source, why}. `source` may be one quote or a list.
author: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Mas'ud, with the commentary of Dikunquz (d. 855 AH)
